lines.text: δυσχρηστίαι τινὲς ἔσονται· ἐὰν δὲ μετὰ Κρόνου οὔσης Σελήνης κληθῇς,
lines.en: there will be some difficulties; but if you are invited when the Moon is with Saturn,

lines.text: ἐξ ἀνάγκης ἀπεπτήσεις καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ δὲ τῷ δείπνῳ ἀηδῶς διατεθήσῃ
lines.en: you will necessarily have indigestion and at the dinner itself you will be unpleasantly disposed

lines.text: διὰ τὸ ῥυπαρὺς πάνυ γενέσθαι καὶ διακονεῖσθαι ἀκαθάρτως, λυπηρῶς
lines.en: because of becoming very dirty and being served uncleanly, you will pass the time sorrowfully;

lines.text: τε διάξεις· ἐὰν δὲ μετὰ Ἀφροδίτης καὶ Ἑρμοῦ ἡ Σελήνη τύχῃ, ὅταν τίς
lines.en: but if the Moon happens to be with Venus and Mercury, when someone

lines.text: σε καλῇ, πορεύου· ἔσται γὰρ πᾶσα εὐφροσύνη τε καὶ ἱλαρία, παιδιαί τε
lines.en: invites you, go; for there will be all gladness and cheerfulness, and games

lines.text: καὶ ὀρχήσεις καὶ εὔστομα σκώμματα καὶ ἀκροαμάτων ἐπιδείξεις.
lines.en: and dances and well-aimed jokes and displays of entertainments.

summary.headline: Lunar Omens for Dinner Invitations
summary.text: Astrological judgments about accepting invitations: the Moon with Saturn foretells indigestion, unpleasant company, unclean service, and sorrow, while the Moon with Venus and Mercury promises cheerfulness, games, dances, jokes, and entertainments.
